items.caption: An oracle-script form of 衣 is drawn as a garment with a raised collar and overlapping sides, matching descriptions of the early graph as clothing.
items.alt: Black line drawing of a garment-like form: a raised central collar above two sloping, overlapping sides.
items.selection_reason: This visible early-style form helps illustrate the supported interpretation of 衣 as a pictograph of an upper garment; its exact specimen and date are not established.

limitations.text: This is a modern redraw in oracle-script style, not an ancient artifact image. Its exact specimen and date are unspecified, so it cannot establish a precise chronology for 衣’s graphic development.
